name: Shabby The Narwhal
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may search the deck for a Downgrade card and add it to your hand. Shuffle the deck.

name: Stabby The Unicorn
description: If this card is sacrificed or destroyed, you may DESTROY a Unicorn card.

name: Swifty Flying Unicorn
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may choose an Instant card from the discard pile and add it to your hand. If this card would be sacrificed or destroyed, return it to your hand instead.

name: The Great Narwhal
description: When this card enters your Stable, you may search the deck for a card with "Narwhal" in its name and add it to yoru hand. Shuffle the deck.

name: Unicorn On The Cob
description: When this card enters your Stable, DRAW 2 cards and DISCARD a card.

name: Unicorn Oracle
description: When this card enters your Stable, look at the top 3 cards of the deck and add on of them to your hand, then return the other two to the top of the deck in any order.

name: Unicorn Phoenix
description: If this card would be sacrificed or destroyed, you may DISCARD a card instead.

name: Back Kick
description: Choose any player. Return a card in that player's Stable to their hand. That player must DISCARD a card.

name: Blatant Thievery
description: Choose any player and look at that player's hand. Choose a card from that player's hand and add it to your hand.

name: Change Of Luck
description: DRAW 2 cards and DISCARD 3 cards, then take another turn.

name: Glitter Tornado
description: Return a card in each player's Stable to that player's hand.

name: Good Deal
description: DRAW 3 cards and DISCARD a card.

name: Kiss Of Life
description: Bring a Unicorn card from the discard pile into your Stable.

name: Mystical Vortex
description: Each player must DISCARD a card. Shuffle the discard pile into the deck.

name: Re-Target
description: Move and Upgrade or Downgrade card from any player's Stable to any other player's Stable.

name: Reset Button
description: Each player must SACRIFICE all Upgrade and Downgrade cards. Shuffle the discard pile into the deck.

name: Shake Up
description: Shuffle this card, your hand, and the discard pile into the deck. DRAW 5 cards.

name: Targeted Destruction
description: SACRIFICE or DESTROY an Upgrade or Downgrade card.

name: Two For One
description: SACRIFICE a card, then DESTROY 2 cards.

name: Unfair Bargain
description: Trade hands with any other player.

name: Unicorn Poison
description: DESTROY a Unicorn card.

name: Unicorn Swap
description: Move a Unicorn card in your Stable to any other player's Stable, then STEAL a Unicorn card from that player's Stable.

name: Caffeine Overload
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may SACRIFICE a card, then DRAW 2 cards.

name: Claw Machine
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may DISCARD card, then DRAW a card.

name: Double Dutch
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may play 2 cards during your Action phase.

name: Glitter Bomb
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may SACRIFICE a card. If you do, DESTROY a card.

name: Rainbow Aura
description: Your Unicorn cards cannot be destroyed.

name: Rainbow Lasso
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may DISCARD 3 cards, then STEAL a Unicorn card.

name: Stable Artillery
description: If this card is in your Stable at the beginning of your turn, you may DISCARD 2 cards, then DESTROY a Unicorn card.

name: Yay
description: Cards you play cannot be Neigh'd

name: Barbed Wire
description: Each time a Unicorn card enters or leaves your Stable, DISCARD a card.

name: Pandamonium
description: All of your Unicorns are considered Pandas. Cards that affect Unicorn cards do not affect your Pandas.

name: Sadistic Ritual
description: If this card is in yoru Stable at the beginning of yoru turn, SACRIFICE a Unicorn card, then DRAW a card.

name: Slowdown
description: You cannot play Instant cards.

name: Nanny Cam
description: Your hand must be visible to all players at all times.

name: Broken Stable
description: You cannot play Upgrade cards.

name: Blinding Light
description: Triggered effects of your Unicorn cards do not activate.

name: Tiny Stable
description: If at any time you have mor than 5 Unicorns in your Stable, SACRIFICE a Unicorn card.

name: Neigh
description: Play this card when another player tries to play a card. Stop their card from being played and send it to the discard pile.

name: Super Neigh
description: Play this card when any other player tries to play a card. Stop that player's card from being played and send it to the discard pile. This card cannot be Neigh'd.
